direction: D10 locally verified incumbent-preserving procedure substitution
evidenceRole: A consumed D9 development-plus-validation mechanism audit followed, only after committed admission, by one untouched read of the 30-question LongMemEval-V2 procedure test split.

graphGPO.borrowedPrinciple: Final trajectory outcomes are noisy step labels. Retain the trajectory-level safety signal while assigning local credit from observed state transitions; progress steps in failed trajectories remain eligible.
graphGPO.scopeDifference: D10 does not train a policy or construct a cross-trajectory shortest-path graph. It uses a conservative deterministic local transition certificate only to curate and rank a bounded procedure capsule above unchanged MemoryCore FTS5.

trajectoryInformedMemory.borrowedPrinciple: Use subtask-granular, provenance-bearing procedural guidance instead of replaying monolithic trajectories.
trajectoryInformedMemory.scopeDifference: D10 does not use an LLM attribution model, inferred outcomes, tip merging, or an LLM selector; local signals and capsule construction are deterministic.

d9NegativeResult.finding: Whole-trajectory outcome gating was harmful on development and did not help on validation; procedure-first packing displaced answer-bearing raw evidence on validation question 767e4106.
d9NegativeResult.designResponse: Use step-local feedback and permit replacement only of exact Base items from the same source trajectory while preserving all unrelated Base items byte-for-byte and in order.

split.testReadRule: No D10 test baseline, candidate, or answer may be materialized before the fixed candidate passes the consumed audit, an independent validator reports zero mismatches, and a committed D10 admission artifact exists.

lockedConsumedBaselines.reuseRule: Recompute Base through the unchanged MemoryCore FTS5 path and require exact query, candidate ids, injected ids, tokens, and direct-support values before using a locked row.

baseline.engine: MemoryCore SQLite L0 FTS5 through executeConversationSearch
baseline.queryTransform: Remove final-answer formatting instructions only; retain the substantive question and options.

candidate.trajectoryCoherence: A procedure is eligible only when its trajectory owns at least one item in the exact Base-injected context, not merely a raw top-k candidate.
candidate.replacementRule: Replace all and only Base-injected raw items owned by one selected trajectory with one capsule at the first removed item's position. Preserve every unrelated Base item byte-for-byte and in its original relative order.
candidate.anchorSafety: Reject empty or over-96-character labels and labels containing digits, URLs, email markers, record/hash markers, or currency symbols. If more than 128 safe anchors are present, decline to exact Base instead of truncating.
candidate.anchorCertificate: Every unique safe anchor extracted from removed raw items must occur in the capsule after the same support normalization.
candidate.costCertificate: The capsule token count must not exceed the exact sum of removed Base-item tokens; total injected tokens and item count must not exceed exact Base.
candidate.nullAction: Any ineligibility, certificate failure, ambiguity, or lack of locally verified actions returns exact Base.

localFeedback.event: One bounded event per observed action transition: procedure id, action index, verified-progress status, deterministic reason, confidence, provenance, and observed timestamp.
localFeedback.progressRule: A step is locally verified only when the post-state has no newly introduced explicit error signal and either the URL changes, an action-target accessibility line disappears, or a new safe interactive anchor appears.
localFeedback.errorRule: A newly added alert, status, or text line containing an explicit failure/error/invalid/denied/forbidden/not-found/exception marker vetoes local progress.
localFeedback.updateRule: Latest valid event for a procedure/action pair replaces the prior event. Unknown ids, invalid indexes or confidence, overflow, corruption, or timeout make the sidecar unavailable and force exact Base.
localFeedback.verifiedArm: Rank same-trajectory procedure candidates by Wilson lower bound of verified-step rate, then verified-step count, FTS rank, and id. Deliver only locally verified abstract actions plus preserved safe anchors.
localFeedback.agnosticAblation: Use the identical candidate pool, replacement rule, anchors, certificates, and bounds, but retain every bounded abstract action and preserve FTS order; do not use local feedback for ranking or action curation.
localFeedback.evolutionBoundary: Only the bounded step-feedback table, same-trajectory procedure ranking, and capsule contents evolve. FTS5, embeddings, raw indexing, question labels, and answer generation remain unchanged.

forbiddenRuntimeInputs: development, validation, audit, or test phase labels

selfOptimization.candidateFreeze: The single fixed policy is frozen before any D10 score. Consumed audit can accept or reject it but cannot change thresholds, bounds, ranking, or capsule rules.
selfOptimization.failureRule: A failed consumed audit rejects D10 without reading test. A failed untouched test rejects D10 without answer-level calls. Any follow-up must be a newly versioned direction.

directMetric.definition: Use the D9 lower-case, hyphen, punctuation, and whitespace-normalized phrase-set support metric. English action counts only match the explicit observed-source-action-count field; list markers never count.
directMetric.orderedSecondary: For ordered phrase questions, all normalized atoms must occur in order within one delivered memory unit.
directMetric.scopeWarning: This is representation-level support evidence, not task accuracy or gold evidence recall; answer-level evaluation remains a later gate.

aggregation.bootstrap: paired stratified question bootstrap by domain

answerLevelGate.claimBoundary: A direct-support pass only admits an answer experiment. Both requested providers must complete before any dual-reader conclusion is reported.
